From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.inference>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference>
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Cross-functional owner matrix and signoff path for HelioHealth evaluation

Alex —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and asks so we can move the evaluation forward:

- Goal: pilot Redwood Inference to reduce per-token cost and baseline latency for HelioHealth's triage assistant.
- Success criteria we agreed on: median p95 latency < 350ms, inference cost <= $0.002/token, no PHI persisted outside VPC.
- Technical stakeholders: you (product), Priya (security), Tom (procurement) — please correct if I missed anyone.

Can you share two things this week:
1) A simple owner matrix (who owns decision, who owns security signoff, who signs PO) — a one-slide org roster or Google Sheet is perfect.
2) The legal/compliance contact and procurement timeline (any vendor paperwork or SOW cadence we should expect).

If it's helpful I can draft a one-email intro to loop in Priya/Tom and propose a short procurement checkpoint. Also attaching a template we use for mapping evaluation owners.

Next steps: if we get the owner matrix by Thu 4/15 we can schedule the compliance deep-dive for the week of 4/19 and lock a pilot scope.

Attachments: [Attachment: HelioHealth-eval-template.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks,

Diego Fernandez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
(d) 415-555-0192

Diego —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers:

- I'll own product signoff. Priya is our security lead and Tom handles procurement/POs.
- I attached an internal spreadsheet that lists owners we use for pilots — it has a couple more names (CS, Infra) you'll want to see.
- Procurement timeline: we're doing a standard Q2 vendor review. Target signoff for pilots is by May 7th; procurement needs an SOW + vendor questionnaire filled out.

I'll upload our org chart to Drive but in the meantime attaching the owner sheet.

[Attachment: HelioHealth-eval-owners.xlsx (xlsx)]
